page_title: CEL 2-0 BIL | Celta Vigo v Athletic Bilbao 14/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Yellow card. Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
90+6' Foul! Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
90+4' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul.
90+4' Celta Vigo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
90+3' A precise low pass is received by Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the left post.
90+1' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is caught offside!
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Hernandez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
84' Ath Bilbao are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
82' Izeta (Ath Bilbao) latches onto a pass inside the box, steps inside his marker and smacks a shot against the left post.
82' Ath Bilbao take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
80' Gorka Guruzeta goes off the pitch and Izeta (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Iago Aspas departs the field of play to be replaced by Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo).
77' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
76' Ernesto Valverde decides to make a substitution. Nico Williams will be replaced by Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao).
76' The substitution has been made. Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) has replaced Williot Swedberg.
74' Ath Bilbao quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
74' Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball goes out of play. Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
73' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
72' Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
70' Selton Sanchez (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
70' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo) takes it short.

69' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
69' Selton Sanchez (Ath Bilbao) gets on the end of a nice cross, but places his close-range header well wide of the left post.
68' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle and signals a foul after Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) brought his opponent down.
66' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.
65' Penalty saved! Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends the penalty low towards the middle of the target, but Ionut Radu doesn't move and easily saves the effort.
65' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
64' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Ath Bilbao!
63' Referee Alejandro Hernandez makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Ath Bilbao. Let’s see what happens!
62' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
61' Claudio Giraldez is forced to make a change. Javier Rueda is unable to continue due to injury, Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) comes on.
61' We are about to witness a subsitution. Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) for Hugo Sotelo.
60' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
57' The linesman signals that Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

55' 2 - 0 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 2:0.
54' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
54' Ionut Radu (Celta Vigo) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
51' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Adama Boiro comes onto the pitch to replace him.

50' Great solo effort from Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.

48' 1 - 0 What a wonderful finish! Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and smashes the ball inside the right post. There are not enough superlatives to describe that goal.
47' The Ath Bilbao players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) is replaced by Selton Sanchez.
46' Half-time substitution. Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) will not participate anymore and Inaki Williams is coming on.
46' Claudio Giraldez makes a half-time substitution. Jones El Abdellaoui comes on in place of Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo).
46' The whistle blows and Alejandro Hernandez starts the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
44' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
43' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
42' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
39' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
39' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
36' Decent spell from Celta Vigo here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in.
34' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 0:4.
34' The foul by Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) was seen by Alejandro Hernandez who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
32' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) receives a cross in the box and attempts to shoot, but mishits the ball and misses the goal.
31' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

28' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards to the bottom left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Ionut Radu pulls off an easy save.
26' Ath Bilbao exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
25' A quickly taken corner by Ath Bilbao.
23' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) commits a rough foul. Alejandro Hernandez stops the game and makes a call.
22' Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.

18' Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Alejandro Hernandez with no other option than to blow for a foul.
17' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
16' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.

16' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
15' Unai Simon (Ath Bilbao) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
10' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
9' Some great controlled play and passing from Ath Bilbao. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
8' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
7' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
6' A pass from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is intercepted by Ionut Radu and the move breaks down.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Celta Vigo will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Alejandro Hernandez.
